Content references, photography credits, and useful information about this corporate website concept.

Source material

This website was prepared as a corporate office website concept at the user’s request. It is not the existing Zorko brand website.

01

Zorko Spotlight · November 2026

The supplied 64-page LV.pdf magazine informs the founders, journey, brand portfolio, office, culture, benefits, partnerships, and photography. The PDF contains outlined text and was reviewed as rendered images.

02

Official company website

Zorko.in supplied corporate background, team names and roles, career application routes, brand links, and contact information. Reviewed 17 November 2026.

03

Content boundaries

No vacancies, employee testimonials, office hours, investment returns, or recruitment outcomes have been invented. Published statistics are source-reported, rather than independently audited.

Privacy & interactions

The enquiry tool prepares an email draft locally in your browser. It does not submit a message or upload form contents to a backend. Your email provider handles any email you choose to send. External brand, map, WhatsApp, and career links have their own policies.

The site uses a Google Fonts stylesheet, which requests font resources from Google. It includes no analytics scripts or marketing cookies. Hosting infrastructure may process ordinary access logs.

The workplace film is the original zorko-gallery.mp4 hosted on Zorko’s official gallery page. Photography includes official portraits and department images from Zorko’s website, together with office and culture photographs from the user-supplied magazine. Publication under an official brand domain should follow the company’s content and rights review.
